title: How to Tailor Your Resume for a Specific Job & Land More Interviews
description:
Your resume's job: To help you get an interview. How do you get more interviews? We're big believers that a strong, tailored resume can play a key part.

In this video, Dave Fano (Teal's Founder & CEO) walks through how to tailor your resume to the job description and land more interviews. 

00:00 How do you get more interviews?
00:32 Check the keywords in a job description
01:16 Use "matching mode" to easily add keywords to your resume
02:06 How to include priority keywords in your achievements
04:22 Look for terms already in your career history
07:10 See how your resume stacks up for different jobs
07:57 Wrap-up & conclusion
